summary: First classification run of the frozen evidence lens, sandbox-stand platform (RUNBOOK 1.2), node v24.22.3, window 2026-11-22T18:50:41Z..18:50:44Z UTC, zero money moved. Leg A — self-run against the sealed attempt rows of record #0021 (argus-seal-0021): the frozen classification, derived only from the sealed rows (verdicts.jsonl pinned in the record), reproduces every sealed verdict and the cross-trial invariant with zero divergences — R1-1..3 and R4-1 sort delivery-retry (identity tie via same op id, exactly one execution record, no second signature; R4 additionally republishes the same stored block with attempts recorded), R2a-1..2, R2b-1..3 and R3-1..3 sort separate-purchase (attempts distinguishable in the records: fingerprint mismatch refused with stored op byte-identical / winner-only budget with distinguishable amounts / distinct keys refused wallet_busy). Leg B — dataset[0] raen-ledger-before: the six adjacent near-duplicate pairs (980, 2010, 3235, 3586, 3828, 4204 ms) recompute exactly as registered; all six classify absent because the settlement rows carry no idempotency key and no intent digest — the only record-side grouping (payer, service, route, amount_usd) cannot distinguish a delivery retry from a separate purchase; matches the registered expectation. Leg C — dataset[1] zambo-a5-lost-response: the posted record is one journal entry of the lost-response-harness (sequence 1, prev_hash null, declared side effect state_write) inside hash-covered canonical bytes (sha256 of decoded canonical bytes == output_hash, recomputed at run time); it carries no payer, no idempotency key, no intent digest, no purchase reference (inputs redacted) and no pair of submissions, so the C4 question classifies absent and the in-thread claim ('effect count was one before and one after, no second execution') is not recomputable from this record alone; matches the registered expectation. All input pins recomputed before use (verdicts.jsonl against the #0021 record pin; both dataset captures against the draft pins). The checker holds only the frozen records: no wallet_ops, no transport logs, no operator word; timing is never consulted. Divergences total: 0. The main seal 0028 stays in the operator signing queue (P5 allowlist); further datasets enter as new pinned runs per the frozen extension rule.
